**Daily Devotional**

**March 28**

*7 And to you who are troubled rest with us, when the Lord Jesus shall be revealed from heaven with his mighty angels, 8 In flaming fire taking vengeance on them that know not God, and that obey not the gospel of our Lord Jesus Christ: 9 Who shall be punished with everlasting destruction from the presence of the Lord, and from the glory of his power; (2 Thessalonians 1:7-9 KJV)*

Entering into the Lord’s rest is being able to rest in the fact that you are saved from the coming judgment of God. Knowing the joy and peace that comes from giving your life to Christ is the only true rest there is. All born again believers need not fear of the coming wrath of God, as if you are saved you will not be judged by God, as He judged His Son Jesus (1 John 2:2) for the sins of the whole world (John 1:29). The only sin that will send a person to Hell is the sin of not believing on Jesus (Hebrews 2:3), or blasphemy against the Holy Ghost (Matthew 12:31-32), or disobeying Jesus (Hebrews 5:9).

This is our assurance that God will avenge all the wrongs done to us when He judges the world. God takes no pleasure in the destruction of the wicked (Ezekiel 33:11), but He will do it. God wishes that all people would repent and be saved (2 Peter 3:9). But be assured, that there is a place called hell and the lake of fire that was prepared for the devil and his angels (Revelation 20:15), but where all the unsaved people will go upon the Day of Judgment (Matthew 25:41). Be sure you are born again, and serve the Lord, as Heaven sure is better than hell. Praise God for our salvation.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
